title: Cardbot
tagline: Telegram bot for digital gift-card sales — catalog, wallet, orders, and an admin panel.
overview: Cardbot (StyleCard) is a production-shaped Telegram commerce bot: bilingual catalog, balances, code delivery, referrals, and a multi-level admin. PostgreSQL plus optional Redis.
problem: Selling digital codes over Telegram without a structured catalog, wallet, and admin meant chaos in chats and spreadsheets.
solution: A Python bot with typed handlers, a SQL schema for users/products/codes/orders, and admin commands for stock and broadcasts.
architecture: main.py entry, handler modules, PostgreSQL schema in db/init.sql, Redis-optional cache, rate limiting and parameterized queries.
features: EN/AR user flows with inline keyboards
challenges: Safe digital-code inventory so a code cannot be sold twice
Admin sessions that span multiple Telegram messages
lessonsLearned: A real schema beats stuffing catalog state into chat memory
futureImprovements: Payment-provider webhooks if a live merchant asks for them
results: A documented, deployable gift-card bot with admin and user sides
